summary: Carry recipient-scoped message identities from the mailbox dispatcher to open streams, avoiding repeated watermark and claim-range reads on message notifications. Export an open-stream census and per-stream notification, update, unchanged-update, routed-update and snapshot work counts in /v1/performance under mailbox_streams.

replay.detail: Durable safety reconciliation retains its cursor and continues covering missed notifications and projection repairs.

schema.detail: No persisted schema changes; the performance report gains additive local work counters.

rules.detail: Message admission, canonical order, bounded recovery and ownership fences are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No mailbox wire-frame or peer protocol change.

recovery.detail: Coalesced identity sets are bounded; overflow or non-message changes use durable reconciliation. Reconnection still begins with a full snapshot.
